signIn.tagline: Track your household net worth without itemising every transaction.

demoNotice.title: Public demo — please read
demoNotice.shared: Everyone shares one account. Anything you enter is visible to, and can be changed by, every other visitor.
demoNotice.noReal: Don't enter real or personal information — treat this as a throwaway sandbox.
demoNotice.wipe: All data is wiped and reset to sample figures every night.
demoNotice.warranty: Provided as-is, with no warranty and no privacy guarantee.
demoNotice.reset: See something offensive? Ask for an out-of-cycle reset via the project link below.

local.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Avoid common passwords.
local.demoHint: This is a shared demo account — just click Sign in. Email: {{email}}, password: {{password}}

invite.title: Set your password
invite.subtitle: You've been invited to join {{household}}. Choose a password to finish setting up your account.
invite.invalid: This invitation link is no longer valid. Ask whoever invited you to send a new one.

resetRequest.title: Reset your password
resetRequest.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
resetRequest.sent: If an account exists for that email, we've sent a link to reset your password. Check your inbox.

resetSet.title: Set a new password
resetSet.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account.
resetSet.invalid: This reset link is no longer valid. Request a new one to continue.

erased.title: Household deleted
erased.body: Your household and everything in it has been permanently deleted. This browser has been signed out.

assets.title: Assets
assets.body: An overview of your assets is coming here. For now, choose a category from the menu.

liabilities.title: Liabilities
liabilities.body: An overview of your liabilities is coming here. For now, choose a category from the menu.

investments.title: Investments
investments.body: An overview of your investments is coming here. For now, choose a category from the menu.

list.noActive_one: No active {{nounPlural}}. {{count}} inactive {{noun}} hidden — tick "Show inactive {{nounPlural}}" to see it.
list.noActive_other: No active {{nounPlural}}. {{count}} inactive {{noun}} hidden — tick "Show inactive {{nounPlural}}" to see them.

snapshot.createDescription: Enter the month-end value. Currency is locked to the position's native currency ({{currency}}).
snapshot.editDescription: Update the amount, statement date, or description. The month can't be changed here.
snapshot.wrongMonthHint: Wrong month? It can't be edited — close this, delete the snapshot from the row menu (⋯), then record a new one in the correct month.
snapshot.deleteDescription: The {{month}} reading will be hidden from reports. To fix a wrong month, record a new snapshot in the correct month after deleting this one.
snapshot.revaluationHintAppreciate: 💡 Suggested {{amount}} — based on +{{magnitude}}% appreciation /yr × {{months}} mo from {{anchor}}.
snapshot.revaluationHintDepreciate: 💡 Suggested {{amount}} — based on −{{magnitude}}% depreciation /yr × {{months}} mo from {{anchor}}.

terminate.description: Mark this position closed, sold, or otherwise terminated. A terminated position stops counting toward net worth from its termination month onward. You can also reopen it by switching back to Active.
terminate.settlementWriteOff: No money came back — write this off
terminate.settlementAlreadyRecorded: A sale is already recorded in this month, so no new one will be added.

untracked.owned: Pick this when it left your books without being sold, spent or lost — you simply stopped tracking it, for example because the person who owns it left the household. Its value is recorded as leaving your records, not as a loss.
untracked.owed: Pick this when the debt left your books without being paid off or forgiven — you simply stopped tracking it, for example because the person who owes it left the household. It is recorded as leaving your records, not as money you paid.

import.title: Import snapshots
import.description: Bulk-add monthly balances from a spreadsheet — handy for backfilling years of history at once.
import.step1Hint: Fill one row per month-end balance (currency defaults to {{currency}}). Open it in Google Sheets, LibreOffice, Numbers, or Excel; save as <bold>.xlsx</bold> (not CSV). You only need the months you actually have a figure for.
import.dropHint: Drag your .xlsx here, or choose a file below.
import.dropActive: Drop the file to select it.
import.invalidFile: That's not an .xlsx file. Fill in the template above and save it as .xlsx.
import.needsFixing_one: {{count}} row needs fixing — nothing was imported:
import.needsFixing_other: {{count}} rows need fixing — nothing was imported:
import.emptyPreview: No rows found in the file. Add some balances and re-upload.
import.preview: Ready: {{insert}} new, {{update}} updated. Nothing saved yet — press Import to confirm.

importCreate.title: Import a {{noun}}
importCreate.description: Create a brand-new {{noun}} from a workbook — its details and full snapshot history, in one step.
importCreate.formatHint: The workbook needs a Detail sheet and a Snapshots sheet. The easiest way to get the right format is to Export an existing {{noun}} and edit it.
importCreate.needsFixing_one: {{count}} thing needs fixing — nothing was created:
importCreate.needsFixing_other: {{count}} things need fixing — nothing was created:
importCreate.preview_one: Ready: a new {{noun}} with {{count}} snapshot. Nothing saved yet — press Create to confirm.
importCreate.preview_other: Ready: a new {{noun}} with {{count}} snapshots. Nothing saved yet — press Create to confirm.

bulkEntry.title: Enter this month's balances
bulkEntry.description: Update the value of each account for the chosen month. Only the ones you change are saved.
bulkEntry.empty: No accounts are eligible for this month yet.
bulkEntry.rowError: This account can't take a value for this month.

investments.title: Enter this month's prices
investments.description: Update the units and price for each holding for the chosen month. The value is worked out for you, and only the ones you change are saved.
investments.empty: No holdings are eligible for this month yet.
investments.rowError: This holding can't take a value for this month.

investmentsAccrued.title: Enter this month's bond & deposit values
investmentsAccrued.description: Update the total value and accrued interest for each bond and time deposit for the chosen month. Only the ones you change are saved.
investmentsAccrued.empty: No bonds or time deposits are eligible for this month yet.
investmentsAccrued.rowError: This holding can't take a value for this month.

owned.acquired: We funded it with money already tracked here
owned.newlyTracked: We already had it, or it came into the household
owned.hint: This tells the report whether the position's first entry was a purchase (so the money came from somewhere else you track) or wealth that was already yours. It only affects how the first month reads.

owed.acquired: We took it on while tracking here — what it paid for is recorded too
owed.newlyTracked: We already owed it, or it came into the household
owed.hint: This tells the report whether the debt was taken on while you were tracking here (so the money it released, or the thing it bought, is recorded too) or was already owed before. It only affects how the first month reads.
